item.title: The lost postcard
item.description: It was the October of 2025 when my wife and I were exploring the beaches and islands of Krabi. Needless to say this was the most relaxing place we had ever been to. The ocean waves put you in a trance. When needed you can also quickly find yourself onto a wavy ocean ride taking you to the pristine islands with breathtaking sceneries or a quick snorkelling dive into the ocean where you get to witness the most beautiful flaura and fauna.

item.title: Are humans really the most intelligent species?
item.description:
Introduction

It’s a widely considered notion amongst humans that we are the most intelligent species on this planet. If someone goes to the extent of validating and questioning the reasoning, many of us would come up with achievements like humans are the only species that came up with the idea of language, society, harnessing resources on the planet, technological innovations, etc.

The Notion

If we pursue the notion, it does make sense. Let’s think if there are any other species on this planet which have been able to build trains or communication technology? Did any species learn how to cook their food? Did they try to understand what lies beyond our planet? Did they ever try to figure out what’s inside them? Did they pursue spirituality?

item.title: The internet is a dead place!
item.description:
Yes! As much as dead it can be. Do you really think you are using those favorite social media, communication or shopping apps? Think again! Because it’s not you who is using them, it’s them using you.

Okay it might feel like just another stupid rant until you see those water and energy hungry computational machines and influence and capital hungry owners behind those little demonic terminals in your hands and everybody else’s hands all around you. Yes I am talking about smart phones.

Hi! I am Ishan Ghorela.

An engineering graduate with his mind constantly tore between the beauty of nature and laws of universe. I am equally intrigued with science as I am fascinated with poetry, stories and thoughts. To be absolutely transparent I have started this blog with an intention to express more in form of my writings which infact could be anything ( you must have already guessed that by now ) related to engineering, fiction or poetry but more importantly to pull my written artifacts out of the highly controlled and monitored ecosystem of technology corporations aka social media platforms. To simplify I don’t want my artifacts to disapper into oblivion with just trigger of a kill switch which is always in hands of a tech corporation ( This sounds crazy but if you look closely this is pretty much the truth ).
